en: You climbed four flights with that face. Sit. Dry mint first, then business.
Back already. The herbs haven't changed, and neither have my prices.
Your sleeve is torn and your hand is shaking. Sit, drink something, then tell me who you hit.
Pink feathers for the wound, yellow for the head. Take what you can carry.
Paid in full, the souq way. Good.
Bring me what you don't need. I weigh fairly. I always have.
That's worth a cup of qishr for both of us.
Not enough riyal. Come back when a job pays, or sell me something first.
Your bag is full. Drink what you carry, or leave something here.
Your purse is full. Spend a little first; I can't weigh coin you can't carry.
You have nothing here I can buy.
Go in peace, and come back with your hands full.
